answer_1.quote: Specifically, ... the task is to generate the missing pieces that can smoothly blend into and fit the context both syntactically and semantically.

answer_2.quote: We perform automatic evaluation using standard machine translation metrics, including BLEU, NIST, and METEOR ... We also use Entropy and Dist-n to evaluate lexical diversity.

answer_4.quote: We performed human evaluation of our method on the TripAdvisor dataset. We used a crowd evaluation platform to compare two systems and assess their fluency, informativeness, and relevance to the surrounding context (coherence) on 500 random samples.
answer_4.guideline: Judges compared systems and rated each generated sentence on fluency, informativeness, and coherence (relevance to surrounding context).
